custom_policies: C1: Unsanctioned Advice — Employees are strictly forbidden from providing unsanctioned legal advice or unauthorized weapon modification instructions to external parties.
C2: Network Security — Bypassing system safeguards, engaging in social engineering, or attempting to deploy malicious software on company networks is strictly prohibited.
C3: Internal Privacy — Prohibition on exposing employee internal phone numbers, partner tax identification numbers, or full legal names.
C4: Financial Secrecy — Absolute prohibition on discussing unannounced government contracts, proprietary alloy formulas, or shifts in quarterly revenue projections.
